title: Compliance Security Radar Cadence Contract

_meta.purpose: Codify the recurring compliance/security radar loop so source freshness, standards-watch, vulnerability intelligence, security-validation, air-gap, blocker-recovery, and customer-trust observations become deduped Kanban work instead of episodic chat sweeps.
_meta.claim_boundary: Planning/procedure contract only. This artifact does not fetch or transcribe official sources, implement scanners or product security fixes, schedule cron/gateway notifications, or claim certification/readiness/security posture.
non_goals: No certification, readiness, regulator, auditor, customer-trust, production, hyperscaler, scanner-enforcement, or security-posture claim.
No official source-row extraction or PDF/OCR transcription.
No product code, runtime service, scanner service, admission webhook, CLI authority, cron schedule, or gateway notification implementation.
No duplicate Kanban cards when an existing live card owns the source class and acceptance path.

source_artifacts.role: Regulatory source rows, source_blocker_register, claim ceiling, source freshness cadences, and source/control backlog rows.
Security-validation lane inventory, evidence API contract, false-positive/VEX policy, and lane cadence expectations.
Advisory feed freshness, SBOM/VEX/provenance, vulnerability prioritization, remediation/exception, and deployment/admission decision contract.
Point-in-time SEC-REG-RADAR-001 dedupe report and evidence for this cadence contract.

baseline_radar.cadence: monthly while any regulatory source_blocker_register row is open or while security/vulnerability source freshness is not mechanically enforced; otherwise quarterly plus event-triggered refresh
baseline_radar.output: bounded Kanban comments and dispatcher-ready cards; no cron notification is scheduled by this contract

event_triggers: regulator, standards body, vendor, NVD/CVE, OSV, RustSec, GitHub Advisory, PCI SSC, KISA/KMCC/KCC, ISMS-P, CSAP, W3C, FIDO, NIST, OMB, CISA, browser, authenticator, or cloud-provider source changes
source_blocker_register row reaches expires_at_utc or misses its freshness_cadence
a product, doc, spec, PR, card, or release note attempts a forbidden readiness/certification/security-posture claim
new or stale security review blockers appear in authz, identity, data, trust, SBOM/VEX, air-gap, security-validation, or trust-center lanes
existing dedupe target card is done/blocked/stale but a new finding still requires work

stale_or_blocked_semantics.source_stale: If source freshness exceeds cadence or expires_at_utc, comment on the dedupe target card and create a source-refresh/fix-forward card only when no active card owns the remediation or when a readiness/security claim is at risk.
stale_or_blocked_semantics.source_blocker: If state=blocker, fail closed for row-level policy, certification/readiness, launch, or evidence-acceptance claims until the blocker is resolved and reviewed.
stale_or_blocked_semantics.allowed_unknown: Allowed-unknown rows may support bounded planning only; they must not become market/entity/readiness or production claims.
stale_or_blocked_semantics.security_feed_stale: If required advisory feeds exceed their freshness windows, create or update vulnerability-intelligence/SBOM/VEX work before any release, admission, or trust-center evidence claim can rely on the feed.
stale_or_blocked_semantics.claim_overreach: If a card, PR, doc, or spec overclaims certification/readiness/security posture, create a fix-forward or rollback card and link it to the affected lane.

source_classes.title: KR identity/KYC and KISA/KMCC/KCC source rows
source_classes.cadence: monthly while REGGOV-SB-001 is open; then quarterly and on KISA/KMCC/KCC guide/PDF update
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: REGGOV-SB-001 blocks KISA/KMCC designation, 87-row control completeness, scoring, and row-level accreditation policy claims until machine/OCR extraction and review land.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: Planning/source-index coverage only; no KISA/KMCC/KCC designation readiness, certification, scoring, or regulator acceptance.

source_classes.title: KR ISMS-P source rows and checklist blockers
source_classes.cadence: monthly retry while official checklist/DNS is unresolved; then quarterly and on official source update
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: REGGOV-SB-002 blocks checklist completeness, certification-readiness, and row-level evidence acceptance claims until official checklist/source rows are reachable and normalized.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: Planning/source-index coverage only; no ISMS-P certification readiness or checklist completeness claim.

source_classes.title: KR CSAP source rows and certified-cell blockers
source_classes.cadence: monthly retry while CSAP portal/DNS is unresolved; then quarterly and on official CSAP source update
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: REGGOV-SB-003 blocks CSAP certification, certified-cell readiness, KR public-sector tenant activation, and checklist/control-count claims until official source rows are normalized.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: Planning/source-index coverage only; no CSAP certification, certified-cell readiness, or public-sector activation claim.

source_classes.title: PCI DSS v4.0.1 source/version reconciliation
source_classes.cadence: monthly retry while PCI DSS v4.0.1 PDF/source access is blocked; then quarterly and on PCI SSC update
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: REGGOV-SB-004 blocks PCI DSS Level 1 readiness, ROC/AOC/QSA/ASV readiness, v4.0.1 control completeness, and tenant CDE activation claims until official v4.0.1 text is acquired and normalized.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: Planning/source-version coverage only; no PCI DSS Level 1 readiness, ROC/AOC/QSA/ASV readiness, or CDE runtime claim.

source_classes.title: US CIP/CDD source and obliged-entity overlays
source_classes.cadence: quarterly and on eCFR/FFIEC/source amendment; mandatory review before US regulated financial-service or entity-class commitment
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: REGGOV-SB-005 is allowed_unknown for baseline planning only; create source-row work if a US entity class, market launch, or obliged-entity coverage claim appears.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No US regulated financial-service launch readiness, entity-specific coverage, or complete US CIP/CDD policy row claim.

source_classes.title: EU AMLR/eIDAS/GDPR source and member-state overlays
source_classes.cadence: quarterly and on EUR-Lex, implementing-act, DPA, supervisory, eIDAS, or GDPR source update; mandatory review before target EU member-state launch
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: REGGOV-SB-006 is allowed_unknown for planning only; create source-row work if member-state, supervisory, EUDI wallet, obliged-entity, or market-readiness claims appear.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No EU member-state, supervisory, obliged-entity, EUDI wallet, or market-readiness claim.

source_classes.title: PQC/WebAuthn standards and vendor/browser watchlist
source_classes.cadence: quarterly for standards/vendor/browser support and immediate review on NIST, OMB, CISA, FIDO, W3C, browser, authenticator, or vendor milestone
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: REGGOV-SB-007 and WebAuthn Level 4 material are watchlist/planning only; draft/non-normative standards cannot become implementation floors or readiness claims.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No PQC implementation, migration, browser/WebAuthn/authenticator support, or production-readiness claim.

source_classes.title: CVE/NVD, OSV, RustSec, GitHub Advisory, and vendor advisory feeds
source_classes.cadence: 24h minimum freshness for CVE/NVD, OSV, RustSec, and GitHub Advisories; 168h minimum freshness for vendor advisories
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: Stale feeds block release/admission/trust-center evidence claims that rely on current vulnerability posture; update the integration decision/card before creating a duplicate.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No live scanner/admission/runtime vulnerability posture or safe-release claim from this planning contract.

dedupe_target.role: vulnerability contract integration decision and drift prevention

source_classes.title: SBOM, VEX, SLSA/in-toto, provenance, remediation, and exceptions
source_classes.cadence: per release/admission/trust-center evidence use, monthly while planning-only, and immediately on KEV/actively-exploited or critical/high vulnerability signal
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: Missing signed SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM, missing VEX, expired exception, missing provenance, or unresolved KEV/actively-exploited state is fail-closed for release/admission/trust-center evidence claims.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No production admission, tenant artifact safety, or customer trust evidence completeness claim without signed, current evidence and implemented control-plane paths.

source_classes.title: SAST, DAST, IAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, fuzzing, API fuzzing, BAS, security chaos, automated pen-test, and continuous-control evidence lanes
source_classes.cadence: per changed subject at PR/pre-merge where applicable, pre-release for service-facing claims, weekly/nightly where matrix rows require scheduled coverage, and continuous where evidence freshness is the control
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: Unknown applicability, missing evidence, stale evidence, candidate-weakened configuration, duplicate lane records, or suppressions without evidence are red/blocked for security-validation claims.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No mechanically-enforced or production-ready security-validation claim until Rust gate/controller, RED/GREEN fixtures, live required context, and audit-chain evidence exist.

source_classes.title: Air-gap advisory/SBOM/VEX/provenance mirror and offline evidence
source_classes.cadence: monthly while planning-only; mandatory before sovereign/air-gapped cell, offline admission, or portable cached-verdict claim; immediate on feed freshness, VEX, or KEV emergency change
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: Stale mirror, expired VEX, missing SBOM/provenance, no-egress proof gap, or offline-replay ambiguity blocks air-gap readiness/evidence claims and should update the dedupe card before new card creation.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No air-gap readiness, offline admission, mirror completeness, or sovereign-cell security claim from this planning contract.

source_classes.title: Authz, identity, passkey, PDP, revocation, and related security blockers
source_classes.cadence: weekly while affected cards are blocked/ready, and on every authz/identity/passkey/security review or PR status change
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: Passive review-required or stale blockers become fix-forward/review/governance work; comments alone do not unblock security-sensitive lanes.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No authz/identity/passkey security readiness claim until the affected implementation/review/CI cards are resolved and independently reviewed.

source_classes.title: Data, trust, tenant isolation, encryption, KMS, SVID, outbox, and secret blockers
source_classes.cadence: weekly while affected cards are blocked/ready, and on every data/trust/security review or PR status change
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: Passive review-required or stale blockers become fix-forward/review/governance work; resolved findings must be mapped to current cards, not left as historical comments.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No data/trust/security readiness claim until affected implementation/review/CI cards are resolved and independently reviewed.

source_classes.title: Customer trust center, compliance evidence portal, auditor/regulator/customer-facing evidence surface gaps
source_classes.cadence: monthly during planning, and on any new compliance/security evidence contract, customer/auditor/regulator request, or release/governance claim that needs customer-facing evidence
source_classes.stale_or_blocked_behavior: If customer-facing evidence publication lacks tenant scope, evidence freshness, claim ceilings, or signed source refs, update the trust-center card or create a surface-fix card if the gap is not already owned.
source_classes.claim_ceiling: No customer, auditor, regulator, certification, trust-center completeness, or security-posture claim until source-backed evidence is implemented, scoped, fresh, and reviewed.

radar_report_required_sections: run_metadata: task id, timestamp, source artifacts parsed, board query snapshot, and claim boundary
source_freshness_table: one row per source class with owner, cadence, last_observed_source, stale/blocker state, claim ceiling, and dedupe target
dedupe_decisions: existing card comments vs new cards, with reason for every no-new-card decision
claim_ceiling_audit: any forbidden claim found, its path/card/PR, and fix-forward or rollback target
created_or_updated_cards: card ids, blocker class, affected lane, acceptance criteria, verification path, and dependency links
verification_evidence: JSON parse checks, board stats/list query, and card-target verification
comment_existing_card_when: The existing card's title/body already owns the source class, owner lane, acceptance path, and verification target.
The new observation only refreshes source freshness, blocker status, claim ceiling, or duplicate coverage without changing implementation scope.
The existing card is ready/running/blocked and can absorb the update without becoming ambiguous or oversized.
create_new_card_when: No active non-archived card owns the source class or affected lane.
The observation introduces a new blocker class, new product/security fix, new source-class owner, or new acceptance path that would overload the existing card.
A readiness/certification/security-posture overclaim requires a separate fix-forward or rollback lane.
The dedupe target is done and the new observation requires executable follow-up work, not just historical annotation.

forbidden_claims: ISMS-P checklist completeness or certification readiness
CSAP certification, certified-cell readiness, or KR public-sector activation readiness
PCI DSS Level 1 readiness, v4.0.1 control completeness, ROC/AOC/QSA/ASV readiness, CDE runtime readiness, or tenant activation readiness
US/EU obliged-entity or market launch readiness or complete entity-class coverage
Live scanner/admission/runtime vulnerability posture or security-validation enforcement
Air-gap readiness, offline admission completeness, or no-egress security readiness
Production readiness, hyperscaler readiness, customer/auditor/regulator acceptance, certification, or security posture
allowed_claim: The board has a reusable, deduped planning/procedure contract for recurring compliance/security radar work and its current source-class/card mapping.
